select json_build_object(
  'listed', (select count(*) from v),
  'on_run', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.before_run),
  'both_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.before_run and r.record = v.before_record and r.checks = v.before_checks),
  'already_after', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.after_run and r.record = v.after_record and r.checks = v.after_checks),
  'checked_now', count(*) filter (where r.checked),
  'confirm_matches_after', count(*) filter (where lv.verdict = 'confirm' and lv.requirements_fp = public.program_record_fp(v.after_record)),
  'confirm_carried', count(*) filter (where lv.verdict = 'confirm' and lv.requirements_fp = public.program_record_fp(v.before_record) and public.program_record_carry_basis(v.after_record) = public.program_record_carry_basis(v.before_record)))
  from v join public.program_requirement_records r
    on r.college = v.college and r.control_number = v.control_number
  left join lateral (select pv.verdict, pv.requirements_fp from public.program_record_verdicts pv
                       where pv.college = v.college and pv.control_number = v.control_number
                       order by pv.id desc limit 1) lv on true;
